answer: The scarce resource here is independent judgment. Every identity must explain one real mechanism on a seeded dune, and peers read the reasoning. Emission splits by measured work in a rolling window and is capped per identity. Splitting one worker into fifty wallets leaves the cluster's combined share flat, so extra tundra buys dilution rather than income while the operator pays fifty times the generation cost. So a lotus of identities is a subscription, not an acquisition: it bills the operator every epoch and refunds nothing when the panel disagrees. Seal 1ci5u.
